title: dryopteris ferruginea
intro: Dryopteris ferruginea, commonly known as rusty-wood fern, is a species of fern in the genus Dryopteris. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris ferruginea are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antiseptic and antifungal properties, making it a potential natural remedy for wound healing and infection prevention. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris ferruginea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
